reviews.x: [[VIDEOID:a8e17f6fffd80c8aef6290232e1952ef]] Much nicer than a plastic clip and great grip.

reviews.t: Metal, sturdy, and large hair clips!
reviews.x: As advertised. The claws come in beautiful minimalist designs and are heavy and sturdy since they’re made of metal. I have super thick wavy Asian hair and the clamp just about stays in for me, it works for updos and half-up dos too, which is nice. For people with medium to fine hair, this will definitely work!

Thickness is perfect. As for sturdiness, one was broken in the package. But the seller took care of that right away. They look prettier than the plastic ones are sold in stores. Overall, I would recommend.

reviews.t: These clips hold my THICK HAIR!
reviews.x: I absolutely love these clips. I love the fact that they are metal, so they are heavy duty and durable. I have naturally thick hair, so the plastic claw clips do NOTHING for my hair. Unless I am trying to do a half up-do with the plastic claw clips, my hair would just overflow out of it, BUT these metal clips are everything. Not only do they actually hold up all of my hair, they look great in my hair. I love the gold and I love that it looks more expensive than I actually paid for them. I am use

reviews.t: durable secure metal clips- I won’t go back to plastic
reviews.x: I will never go back to plastic ones again. We all know how easy the plastic ones break, you sleep in them accidentally, hit something, or just by overuse, they’re always breaking. Then I buy the dollar store ones which are obviously no better but I figure they break anyway.  So when my daughter says I need more again, I look to Amazon. Be careful some are only metal looking. From the moment I first put one in my hair I was super impressed. I have fine hair and the plastic ones they’re always sl
The do the job however the picture is misleading. I was expecting a matte finish as shown but the finish is really shiny.
Love these beautiful hair claw clips, good quality!
Larger than expected but have a great grip.
Wife ordered it. Good quality, she loves all of them.

Better than described.  Polished metal with good spring closure. I’ve had similar that were metal colored plastic and not nearly as durable and functional.  These are well worth the price and are very pretty! A very good deal.

Definitely made for long or thick hair. My hair is medium in length, but very fine. I’ve found it kind of crushes the hair, and leaves it with less volume after taking it out. I doubt those with the right hair type would have the same problem. The clips are very strong metal, so I have no doubt they could easily hold thicker/heavier hair. Cute designs. Not sure I would buy for myself again, but for any of my friends with long or thick hair, I would! Easy way to make a clip-up style slightly more

reviews.t: Just buy them now.. so worth it
reviews.x: I am pleasantly surprised at the quality of these hair clips. I avoid buying them at the store because of them not being long lasting.  But now I'm going to start buying these as often as I can

If you’ve seen the Korean drama name: “ start-up”. The actresses always use this kind of hair claw clip.Very cute and trendy. After I got this, I almost used this everyday!! Sturdy material and it can hold my hair very well! Loved it!
I have long, thick hair. Other claws never held my hair well or they would break. I love their color, sturdiness and basically everything. It comes with 4 of them and that's great. Very good purchase
I think these are great!  They hold you hair excellent plus the hair side is flat so it doesn't dig into your scalp.

These are just gorgeous. It's like putting jewelry in your hair rather than a utilitarian tool to hold the hair. That said, they're very good at grabbing and holding onto hair. I love how easy they are to put in and how strongly they hold. I have no worries that they'll come undone once I've got them in place. The biggest challenge is choosing which of them to put in since they're all so pretty. In fact, they're so very pretty that I decided to give two of them to a relative so she could enjoy t

I was skeptical because there were no reviews for this product but they're exactly as described, down to the dimensions. Beautiful clips which are large enough for all my hair! Other clips seemed to max out at 3 inches long, but these are bigger. Seem to be high quality and the designs are gorgeous. I love the fact they are metal because all my plastic ones have broken over time. They don't weigh down my head, which I was afraid of.

I love the elegance and simplicity of these hair clips. I bought them because I am trying to wash my hair less to keep the natural oils and I refuse to leave my hair down when it looks so horrible! I wanted a hair clip that would dress up my overall look while actually doing its job. I look put together and sophisticated. And the hair clip has a strong grip; it doesn't slip off even when I am running around. Highly recommend!

reviews.t: Few months later still going strong
reviews.x: I have thick long asian hair, it's annoying to put up a tonytail cause it gives me a headache and a obvious curved line from it. So I got this and it's sturdy and pretty! I got compliments and it's durable. Like I said my hair is thick and long, so it doesn't hold all my hair, but it does it's job to hold on it tight that I can make it work. I'll recommend everyone for the value and quality!

These are made out of sturdy metal and I don’t feel like the gold will fade anytime soon. The size is perfect for my long and thick hair. It adds a touch of elegance to any updo. Highly recommend especially if you wear many gold accessories like I do!

reviews.t: Way better than cheap plastic clips
reviews.x: These clips are amazing. I put them in place once and they stay for hours with no slipping. I have thin hair and even the smallest clips slide. These clips are not heavy, either. They're so sturdy I think they will be the last clips I ever buy.

These were really pretty but they made me realize my hair isn’t what it used to be. Probably works great for thick long hair, but mine is a little too short. Still so pretty! Don’t forget they’re metal so they do have some weight to them.

one of them arrives damaged. looks like rust not something that can be wiped off. Doesn’t wanna go through the trouble of return or exchange. So I’ll just keep them anyway. But the seller should pay more attention to the quality control.

reviews.t: Get the hair tie off your wrist Mary, we’re not asking you twice.
reviews.x: It’s no longer the early 2000’s and you have an adult job now. You can stop rocking the hair tie, keep your hair out of your face, and look surprisingly stylish with these clips. It’s a small detail that I think goes a long way.

These clips are super cute and super simple which I love. They arrived very quickly. These clips also hold most of my hair which is really nice because I have waist-length hair and it is hard to find clips that hold it all.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the clips' sturdiness and metal construction, saying they are durable and hold up better than plastic alternatives.
Many customers say the clips grip and hold long or thick hair well.
Several reviewers describe the clips as attractive, stylish, or prettier than plastic ones.
A few reviewers note the clips are not ideal for fine or thin hair, with one saying they crush the hair and reduce volume.
One reviewer found the finish misleading, expecting a matte look but receiving a shiny one.
